description: Even in a container without a notification daemon, the dock shows four launchers and performs hover zoom without showing notification badges.

assertions.comment: The dock window displays normally at 1024x108 even when notification-daemon registration fails.
All four default pinned launchers are created without a notification daemon.
Launcher hover zoom works from 1.0 to the default 1.6 without a notification daemon.
Moving the cursor outside the dock returns the scale to 1.0 regardless of the notification daemon.
With no notification daemon or notification input, the first launcher has 0 unread badges.
The badge element at the unnamed fixed child path is not visible when there are no notifications.
The attention state is not activated incorrectly without a fake notification.
